s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic scrotal swelling with acute worsening and a palpable testicular mass
salient_findings: Firm, smooth testis without discrete nodules or tenderness
Well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow on ultrasound
key_facts: 49-year-old man
Left testicular bloating and dull pain for 20 years
Acute worsening of symptoms over the past 10 days
No other medical history
Left testis was enlarged, firm, and smooth on examination
Transillumination was negative
Scrotal Doppler ultrasound showed bilateral epididymal cysts
A 1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow
Small left hydrocele
Elevated serum CA19-9 level of 57.5 U/mL
Normal alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, and other tumor markers

shortlist.label: Seminoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common testicular cancer, matches palpable testicular mass and acute worsening

shortlist.label: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Common testicular cancer, consistent with elevated CA19-9 and palpable mass

shortlist.label: Testicular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of testicular swelling and acute worsening, especially in older adults

shortlist.label: Leydig cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause testicular enlargement and hormone elevation, consistent with some case findings

shortlist.label: Embryonal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive testicular cancer, possible cause of rapid worsening and elevated tumor markers

rule_in.why: it is more commonly associated with testicular enlargement

rule_out.why: it is compatible with all testicular conditions

trace.fact: Firm, smooth testis without discrete nodules or tenderness

rule_in.why: it is often associated with a firm, smooth testis

rule_out.why: it often presents with testicular swelling and tenderness
it does not discriminate between the candidates

rule_in.why: it is most consistent with a well-circumscribed hypoechoic testicular lesion

rule_out.why: finding is compatible with all testicular tumors

rule_in.why: age is not specific to any candidate

rule_out.why: age is compatible with all candidates
